glft._comment: Paper uses configured A/k only as a labeled proxy. Live ignores public aggTrade and requires a hashed LIVE_BINANCE_RPI_ACK exposure artifact.

gate._comment: Keep max_bps below half of the minimum quoted spread so alpha shifts fair value without collapsing the two-sided quote.

predictor._comment: Horizons are in strategy cycles. A horizon only shifts quotes after its live prequential R^2 vs fair_value=mid exceeds min_oos_r2 over min_oos_samples scored predictions.

adaptive._comment_fast_requote: Paper-only. On a mid move of max(trigger_bps, min_trigger_ticks ticks) from the mid the quotes were priced at, cancel the quote on that side and reprice now instead of waiting for the cycle; min_interval_ms caps how often. 1.5 ticks keeps a quote resting through a one-level flicker of a large-tick book (KORUUSDT ~7 bps/tick) and is ~1 bps on small-tick books.

execution._comment_paper_touch: Paper-only and per symbol. A side whose model price is within paper_touch_snap_ticks of the touch joins it if it still clears the one-way fee against fair value; a snapped quote keeps paper_min_spread_bps rounded down to whole ticks of that symbol (at least one tick), so a one-tick book wider than the floor in bps (KORUUSDT ~7 bps/tick) can be quoted on both sides. Live keeps min_spread_bps and never snaps.

paper_queue_imbalance._comment: Paper-only, learned per symbol from the public L1 book: P(next mid move | queue imbalance (bid_qty - ask_qty) / (bid_qty + ask_qty)). A side whose next move is more than against_threshold likely to go against it is quoted one level behind the touch, and a quote resting at the touch is pulled. On 9 h of KORUUSDT, imbalance below -0.4 preceded a down move 75-91% of the time. No step-back until a bin has min_moves_per_bin moves of evidence.
paper_queue_imbalance._comment_disabled: Off since 2026-10-14: it predicts the next move but not our fill P&L. On ~230 KORUUSDT fills, queue fills taken with the imbalance against us still marked out +3.0 bps at 5 s (t=2.0), so stepping back gave them up, while the most toxic through-fills (-3.6 to -4.2 bps at 1 s, t<-2.4) came with the imbalance neutral or in our favour: sweeps of a thick queue it cannot see.

paper_inventory_step_back._comment: Paper-only, in whole ticks of each symbol: the side that adds inventory steps back one tick per lots_per_tick lots (one lot = the quote notional), up to max_ticks, after touch snapping; the reducing side stays at the touch. GLFT's bps skew rounds away below a tick (~7 bps on KORUUSDT), so at the 2026-10-14 KRX open inventory reached ~4.9 lots in two minutes.

paper_intensity._comment: Paper-only per-symbol A/k for GLFT (Live uses the frozen signed artifact). Prior A comes from the queue-adjusted public trade rate at the touch (rate / queue ahead), falling back to prior_A_per_s until observed; own quotes' exposure and fills then update A with a Gamma-Poisson posterior worth prior_strength_fills fills, and move k toward the own-fill MLE once fills span enough depths. Override any field per symbol under symbols.<SYMBOL>.
paper_intensity._comment_symbols: KORUUSDT is off: on a ~7 bps tick where the price often jumps several levels, fills one level behind the touch arrive (as adverse through-fills) about as often as queue fills at the touch, so the depth model collapsed (k 1.0 -> 0.28, A -> 0.016/s), GLFT widened to ~15 bps and sizing stopped quoting. It falls back to the calibrator's configured A/k until large-tick quoting is level-based.

queue_retention._comment: Binance re-queues on every cancel/replace and modify. More-aggressive drift (1 tick, or size above target by the ratio) moves at once; more-conservative drift moves only past the tolerance and after min_rest_sec (>=5s keeps Binance ICR safe). New quote orders are capped per symbol per UTC 10-minute window, far below the ICR 5000 and dust-ratio 10000 order thresholds.
